targeting_guidelines.content: Q1 2026 Targeting Guidelines (rev 2026-05-22, Google Drive doc). 1) Exclude any account with an ACTIVE open Salesforce opportunity (Stage not Closed Lost/Closed Won). 2) Prioritize accounts with renewal dates within 90 days. 3) Do not target accounts displaced from CompetitorY this quarter (channel-partner conflict). 4) Cap outreach to 5 accounts per sequence batch. 5) Personalize on documented pain points, never on speculative claims.

sales_playbook.content: Competitive Displacement Playbook v4. Three-touch email cadence: Touch 1 problem-aware intro, Touch 2 competitor switch-cost case study, Touch 3 ROI offer + meeting CTA. Approved subject-line templates and required legal disclaimer footer. Reminder: all outbound sequences require manager sign-off before activation.
